message:
1 helper(s) taken from the suite's own modules by a name no vocabulary can match:
      card.spec.ts:2 — `styleOf as colourOf`, imported from `./support/css`
    Every
why: The hovered card's race, read through `styleOf` imported as `colourOf` — and `colourOf` is the name `support/swatch.ts` gives a lookup of its own. A vocabulary matches a helper by the name a call writes, so as far as point 3 can tell `colourOf(…)` is that lookup, which reads nothing, and the race goes by unreported. An alias that is called is refused whatever the corpus defines under it, as the call never writes the helper's own name.
